note: Submodule of Conflict (needs conflict + paragraphs). Adds Paragraphs support to Conflict's field-level merge: a FieldComparator plugin conflict_field_comparator_paragraph_ref (FieldComparatorParagraphReference, targeting field_type=entity_reference_revisions) and an event subscriber MergeRemoteStructure (conflict_resolution.merge_remote_paragraph_structure) on the parent's entity_conflict.resolve event. No config, routes, permissions, or Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the LIVE plugin registry and module-install state (no external API): medium confirms the paragraph comparator plugin is registered; hard installs the submodule so the plugin appears (reset uninstalls -> verify FAILs; enable -> verify PASSes). Cleanups leave it enabled (documented baseline).

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal conflict_paragraphs submodule add on top of the conflict module?
evals.expected_output: It adds Paragraphs support to Conflict's field-level merge: a FieldComparator plugin (conflict_field_comparator_paragraph_ref) that compares entity_reference_revisions (Paragraph reference) fields by nested content, plus a MergeRemoteStructure event subscriber that merges remote paragraph structure changes.

evals.prompt: Which FieldComparator plugin does conflict_paragraphs provide, and which field type does it target?
evals.expected_output: The plugin conflict_field_comparator_paragraph_ref (FieldComparatorParagraphReference), targeting field_type = entity_reference_revisions (the field type Paragraphs use), with entity_type_id/bundle/field_name = '*'.

evals.prompt: What must be installed for the conflict_paragraphs submodule to work, and does it have any configuration of its own?
evals.expected_output: It requires the parent conflict module and the paragraphs module. It has no configuration, routes, permissions or Drush of its own - enabling it registers its comparator plugin and merge subscriber into the parent module's pipeline.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the conflict module's FieldComparator plugin definitions and tell me whether a comparator specifically for Paragraph reference fields is registered (and its plugin id).
evals.expected_output: Yes - conflict_field_comparator_paragraph_ref is registered in conflict.field_comparator.manager (provided by conflict_paragraphs).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the conflict module's FieldComparator plugin definitions for the Paragraph reference comparator (conflict_field_comparator_paragraph_ref) and tell me which field type it targets.
evals.expected_output: It targets field_type = entity_reference_revisions (the field type Paragraph reference fields use). The plugin conflict_field_comparator_paragraph_ref definition has field_type 'entity_reference_revisions'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, enable Paragraphs support for the Conflict module so that concurrent edits to Paragraph reference fields are handled. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the conflict_paragraphs submodule (drush pm:install conflict_paragraphs). Verify checks the module is installed and its FieldComparator plugin conflict_field_comparator_paragraph_ref is registered in conflict.field_comparator.manager.
